references.summary: Root crop grown for sugar; distinct from vegetable table beet. Prolonged cold after a susceptible stage can induce bolting; a short frost episode is a different exposure. Hot conditions increase evaporative demand and can affect root growth and sugar accumulation. White rot and some root pathogens have broad host ranges; merely changing botanical family may not remove risk. Sugar concentration, root yield and recoverable sugar yield are separate outcomes; bolting reduces suitability for root production.
